tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// dpal ldan srog gi bdud mo mched lnga'i mngon rtogs mchod 'grigs spu gri reg gcod bzhugs so//

1$0000250srog bdag ma la phyag 'tshal lo// 1$0000300bdag nyid yi dam du gsal ba'i mdun du khaṃ yongs su gyur pa las/ gnam lcags las grub pa'i khang sgrom nag po gru gsum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ phyi na zhe sdang gi me 'bar ba/ nang du gti mug gi mun pa 'thibs pa/ 'dod chags khrag gi rgya mtsho khol ba/ nga rgyal gyi brag ri gshibs pa/ phrag dog gi rlung nag 'tshubs pa/ nad kyi na bun 'thibs pa/ dug gi rlangs pa 'thul ba/ mtshon gyi bu yug 'tshubs pa/ phyi nas skyabs pa nang du mi thar ba/ nang nas bros pa phyir mi thar ba/ de'i nang du dgra bgegs byad ma gan rkyal du mnan pa'i steng du/ dur khrod thod mkhar me rlung 'tshubs ma 'khyil ba'i dbus su ma bh+yo dzaḥyongs su gyur pa las/ gsod byed lha mo sku mdog nag mo/ srin mo'i gdong pa can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ spyan gsum mche ba bzhi gtsigs pa/ dbu skra sma ra ba spu thams cad mtshon char 'dug pa/ phyag g.yas ral gri /g.yon rtse gsum/ mi lpags rlon pa'i stod g.yogs gsol ba mi mgo rlon pa lnga bcus do shal byas pa/ dgra bo'i glo snying zhal du gsol zhing*/ 'jigs su rung ba/ de'i g.yas su gsod byed lha mo dmar mo ce spyang gi gdong pa can/ ro la bcibs pa/ g.yon du lha mo smug nag wa'i gdong pa can/ de gnyis kas g.yas gri gug g.yon zhags pa bsnams pa/ mdun du las mkhan ma ljang nag 'ug pa'i gdong pa can/ mig gnyis nyi zla'i zer bas rno ba/ rgyab tu kham nag dred mong gi gdong pa can/ rkang lag gnam lcags kyi sder mo can/ de gnyis ka yang g.yas ral gri g.yon rtse gsum bsnams pa/ de thams cad kyang gtso mo'i cha byad can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum mche ba gtsigs pa/ mi lpags rlon pas stod g.yogs/ thod rlon lnga bcus do shal byas pa/ dgra bo'i glo snying zhal du gsol ba/ shin tu khros shing gtum pa/ 'khor sha za 'bum sde/ ma mo bye ba 'bum sde'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/

bzhengs pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o// thugs kar ma bh+yo dzaḥ'i sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ srog bdud las kyi ma mo 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad/ ma bh+yo dzaḥs pa ri bā ra sa ma ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ/ ma hā māṃ sa/ rak+ta/ tsit+ta/ ba su ta/ go ro tsa na/ kiṃ ni ri ti/ pañca a mṛta/ ma hā ba liṃ ta khā hi/ bstod bskul ni/ 1$0000270bh+yo/ thod mkhar nang na sku bzhugs/1$0000300 zhes sogs dang*/ spyan 'dren ni 'di skad do// bh+yo/ dur khrod rda ra li zhes bya ba na// nyin mo dud pas bar snang 'khrigs// mtshan mo rlung 'tshubs me ltar 'bar// 'jigs su rung ba'i dur khrod nas// dpal ldan lha mo srin mo yang*/ nag mo chen mo mi srun ma/ gsod byed lha mo gshegs su gsol// sha la za zhing khrag la 'thung*// nyin re mi brgya gsod pa mo// mtshan mo yang ni brgya brgya gsod// sha za ḍā ki gshegs su gsol// rdzu 'phrul nus pa dpag med kyang*// phyi rabs don du gnang phyir kyang*// dpal ldan lha mo gshegs su gsol// srog bdud nag mo gshegs su gsol// dmar mo ce spyang gdong can gshegs su gsol// smug nag wa yi gdong can gshegs su gsol// ljang nag 'ug pa'i gdong can gshegs su gsol/ kham nag dred mong gdong can gshegs su gsol/ dmar mo gcan gdong gshegs su gsol// smug nag wa gdong= ljang nag 'ug gdong= kham nag dred gdong= bstan srung nag mo 'khor bcas rnams// skad cig tsam gyis gshegs su gsol// ma bh+yo dzaḥbadz+ra sa ma ya dza dzaḥ de ltar 'bod pa'i sngags kyis spyan drangs nas/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod pa 'bul/ bh+yo/ thod mkhar nang na sku bzhugs pa'i// mthing nag mi srun srin mo'i gdong*// gsod byed dmar mo ce spyang gdong*// lha mo smug nag wa yi gdong// sha za ljang nag 'ug pa'i gdong*// sgrol byed kham nag dred mong gdong*// sha za khrag 'thung 'bum dang ni// ḍā ki'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ

pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ/ ma hā māṃ sa la khā hi/ bh+yo/ dgra bgegs rnams ni bsgral pa yi/ khrag gi yon chab dam pa 'di// lha mo 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas dgra bgegs bsgral du gsol// dgra bgegs rnams ni bsgral pa yi// dbang po lnga yi me tog 'di// lha mo 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas dgra bgegs bsgral du gsol// dgra bgegs rnams ni bsgral pa yi// sha chen gsur gyi bdug spos 'di// lha mo 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas dgra bgegs bsgral du gsol// dgra bgegs rnams ni bsgral pa yi// zhun chen gsal ba'i mar me 'di// lha mo 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas dgra bgegs bsgral du gsol// dgra bgegs rnams ni bsgral pa yi// mkhris las skyes pa'i dri chab 'di// lha mo 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas dgra bgegs bsgral du gsol// dgra bgegs rnams ni bsgral pa yi// rkang las skyes pa'i zhal zas 'di// lha mo 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas dgra bgegs bsgral du gsol// dgra bgegs rnams ni bsgral pa yi// rkang dung thod rnga rnge'u chung 'di// lha mo 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas dgra bgegs bsgral du gsol// dgra bgegs rnams ni bsgral pa yi// gzugs dang sgra dang dri dang ni// ro dang de bzhin reg bya'i tshogs// 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga po yang*// lha mo 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas dgra bgegs bsgral du gsol// ma bh+yo dzaḥ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ pā d+yaṃ= puṣ+pe= dhū pe= ā lo ke= gan+dhe= nai bid+ya= shab+da swā hā/ la sogs pas mchod nas/ bstod pa ni/ ma bh+yo dzaḥ gnam lcags khang sgrom 'bar ba la// phyi nas zhe sdang me 'bar lhabs se lhab// nang na gti mug mun pa thibs se thib// 'dod chags khrag gi mtsho mo kyi li li// nga rgyal brag ri dmar po khra la la// phrag dog rlung nag 'tshub ma 'u ru ru// nad kyi na bun nag po thibs se thib// dug gi rlangs pa nag po phyu ru ru// mtshon cha sna tshogs bu yug tshubs se tshub// phyi nas skyabs pa nang na mi thar zhing*// nang nas bros pa phyi ru thar mi srid// de nang dgra bgegs gan rkyal mnan pa'i steng*// dur khrod thod mkhar me rlung 'khyil ba'i dbus// dpal ldan lha mo gsod byed 'jigs pa'i gzugs// zhal gcig phyag gnyis srin mo'i gdong pa can// phyag g.yas ral gris dam nyams srog rtsa gcod// g.yon pas rtse gsum dam nyams snying rjen gtur// spyan gsum sdang mig gdug pa'i bya ra byed// dbu skra sma ra ba spu mtshon char 'bar// mche ba bzhi gtsigs khrag gi kha chu 'dzag

/sdang byed dam nyams glo snying zhal du gsol// shangs nas thog mda' mtshon gyi bu yug 'tshubs// mi lpags rlon pa'i stod g.yogs sku la gsol// mi mgo khrag 'dzag lnga bcu'i do shal mdzad// ag tshom me 'bar skan sgra chems se chem// chibs su rlung 'chib stong gsum skad cig bskor// dam nyams sha za klad khrag gsol byed ma// srog gcod bdud mo'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// bh+yo/ g.yas kyi las mkhan dmar nag ce spyang gdong*// zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug zhags pa 'debs// ro la 'chib cing dam nyams sha la za// shan pa srog gcod khyed la phyag 'tshal bstod// g.yon gyi pho nya smug nag wa yi gdong*// zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug zhags pa 'phen// dur khrod 'grim zhing mi yi bla tshe len// dgra bgegs gsod byed khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// mdun gyi las mkhan ljang nag 'ug pa'i gdong*// zhal gcig phyag gnyis ral gri rtse gsum bsnams// spyan ni rno zhing dgra bo'i mig 'bru ma// ltas ngan gtong byed khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// rgyab kyi pho nya kham nag dred mong gdong*// zhal gcig phyag gnyis ral gri rtse gsum bsnams// lcags kyi sder mos dgra bgegs glo snying 'dren// bdud mo sgrol byed khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// bh+yo/ srog gi bdag mo dpon g.yog 'khor bcas rnams// ma g.yel ma g.yel lha mo srung ma'i tshogs// sngon gyi bde bar gshegs pa'i spyan snga ru// ji ltar khas blangs dam tshig dgongs mdzod la// ma ltar bsten no lha mo byams ma g.yel// sring ltar bsten no lha mo snying ma ring*// mdza' ltar bsten no lha mo gzhung ma ngan// bran ltar bsten no lha mo las ma g.yel// 'bod pa'i dus na lha mo snyan ma sra// g.yab pa'i dus na lha mo spyan ma rtul// sgrub pa'i dus na lha mo mthu ma chung*// rbad pa'i dus na lha mo rtsal ma zhan// sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la// dam nyams dgra yi yul du dmag sna drongs// dam nyams dgra bo las ngan 'khor bcas 'dis// sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyan po 'di yis bshigs// dkon mchog dbu 'phang gnyan po 'di yis smad// bdag gi dge ba'i bar du 'di yis bcad// de bas dgra bo bsgral ba'i zhing yin pas// ma g.yel ma g.yel lha mo 'khor bcas rnams// rgyug rgyug breng breng dgra bo'i steng du rgyugs// dam nyams dgra bo las ngan 'khor bcas kyi// sha rus phyes la don snying nang khrol drongs// srog rtsa chod la snying khrag khong nas 'jibs// gdong gi 'od 'phrog khong dbugs long la shog

/mchan gyi bu sod lus sems phrol la thongs// 'og gi rta sgyel chung ma gsod par gyis// rigs rgyud rtsad chod gdung rgyud rmang nas skoms// yul zhing bang khang thams cad sa dang sres// mi nor 'khor bcas lhag ma med par bzhes// sa gzhi rdul bcas rjes med nyid la thongs// de ltar ma byas lha mo dam tshig nyams// de bas dam tshig srung ba'i dus la bab// sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba'i dus la bab// dkon mchog dbu 'phang bstod pa'i dus la bab// bla ma'i sku tshe bsring ba'i dus la bab// rnal 'byor bar chad bsal ba'i dus la bab// bdag gi phrin las sgrub pa'i dus la bab// dam nyams dgra bo bsgral ba'i dus la bab// de bas nag mo chen mo 'khor bcas rnams// rnal 'byor bcol pa'i las 'di khyod kyis sgrubs// ma mo nag mo 'khor dang bcas pa la// gus pa'i tshul gyis bdag gis phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rang gi mdun du ma mo nag mo shin tu khro zhing gtum pa/ gtso mo 'dra ba 'bum phrag du ma bsam/ bdag gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas ma mo 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul bar bsam la/ dgra bgegs thams cad dbang med du bkug cing*/ bka' nyan gyi tshul du bskyed la/ sngags 'di bgrang ngo*// oṃ khyi kha le nag mo dgra bo dzaḥ srog la ma tri dzaḥ snying kha la baṃ dzaḥ tsa pa la ru lu dzaḥ ya ya dzaḥ gha ya dzaḥ nṛ ya dzaḥ rag mo tse tse ti sta dgra bo'i tsit+ta la rbad rbad dzaḥ rag mo tsi tsi ti sta dgra bo'i tsit+ta la rbud rbud dzaḥ rag mo rag mo gzir nan: khong dbugs gzir drongs/ dgra bo'i tsit+ta la myag thuṃ ril rbad sod ma dza dzaḥ dus bzhir gtor ma 'bul/ rtsa sngags kyi mthar dgra bgegs kyi māṃ sa la khā hi sogs kyis bsngo'o// de nas bskul ba ni/ ma bh+yo ma bh+yo ma bh+yo/ ma mo sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yo// ma mo gnod pa'i bgegs la bh+yo// ma mo bar chad rkyen la bh+yo// bh+yo/

mkha' 'gro nag mo mi bsrun ma// sha za khrag mig srin mo'i gdong*// 'jigs pa'i gzugs la rngam pa'i sku /sku mdog nag mo char sprin mdog /zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa// phyag na gcod byed mtshon cha bsnams// chibs su srid pa'i rlung la bcibs// myur mgyogs stobs kyis dgra bgegs sgrol// ral pa mtshon cha sha ra ra// gcer bu mi lpags gos su gyon// dgra bo'i glo snying dmar po ni/ khrag 'dzag rgyun du zhal du gsol/ khrag gi kha chu tsa ra ra// ljab ljab ljib ljib khrag la 'thung*/ khram khram khrum khrum rus la mur// rkan rdeb dgra bo'i lhu tshigs phyes// spyan mig dmar po glog ltar 'khyugs// ag tshom dmar ser me ltar 'bar// mi yi mgo snying zhal du gsol// so dang mche ba spu gri'i so// ba spu mtshon cha'i bu yug 'tshubs// shangs nas mtshon cha 'tshub ma 'gyed// sma ra mtshon cha me ltar 'bar// reg pas dgra bo rdul du brlag /mi mgo rlon pa'i do shal byas// mkha' 'gro nag mo mi bsrun ma// ma 'dir gshegs brgyan pa'i gtor ma bzhes// dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag gtor ma bzhes// thugs dam bskangs la phrin las mdzod// rgyal ba'i bka' las ma 'da' bar// dgra bo'i sha zo khrag la thungs// dgra bo khrag skyug nad kyis sod// bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod// bh+yo/ g.yas na rgyug pa'i las mkhan ma// gsod byed nag mo ce spyang gdong*// ro la chibs shing sha la za// dam nyams dgra bo'i sha la zo// bh+yo/ g.yon na rgyug pa'i las mkhan ma// smug nag wa yi gdong pa can// dur khrod 'grim zhing mi sha len// dam nyams dgra bo'i bla tshe longs// bh+yo/ mdun na rgyug pa'i las mkhan ma// sha za ljang nag 'ug pa'i gdong*// mig gnyis nyi ma'i zer bas rno// dgra bo'i mig 'bras rtsad nas chod// bh+yo/ rgyab na rgyug pa'i las mkhan ma/ kham nag dred mong gdong pa can// rkang lag gnam lcags sder mo can// lcags sder mtshon chas glo snying 'dren// las mkhan chen mo mched bzhi ni// kun kyang gtso mo'i cha byad can// zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa// phyag na gcod byed mtshon cha bsnams// chibs su srid pa'i rlung la 'chib/

/1$0000270myur mgyogs 1$0000300 sogs byas kyang rung/ ma byas kyang rung*/ bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod// bh+yo/ srog bdud nag mo mched lnga yang*// skad cig stong gsum nyul bar byed// sha za khrag 'thung 'bum gyis bskor/ khams gsum ma lus zas su za// srid gsum ma lus skom du 'thung*// sha za dpon g.yog 'khor bcas rnams// ma gnas 'dir byon la mchod pa bzhes// dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma bzhes// dgra bo'i sha khrag gtor mar bzhes// ma khyod la bcol ba'i phrin las ni// dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i dus la bab// pho nya gtong ba'i dus la bab// ma g.yel myur du dgra bo sod// bsad rtags don snying khyer la shog /sngon tshe bde gshegs spyan snga ru// ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas ltar// bka' dang dam la ma 'da' bar// bdag la sdang ba'i dgra bo 'di'i// srog rtsa dmar po rtsad nas chod// snying rjen dmar po dum bur gtubs// snying khrag dmar po sa dang sres// phyi yi gzugs kyi phung po gtubs// nang gi rtsa rgyus drwa ba khrol// pha tshan nang na skya lings gyis// ma tshan nang na gri lings gyis// 'khor ba las kyi klong nas gtor// 'jig rten lha 'dres rngams zas gyis// la las phyi yi tshogs la rol// la las nang gi tshogs la rol// bem rig phrol la lus sems phyes// rnam par shes pa'i mar me de// skye ba med pa'i dbyings su sgrol// 'gag pa med pa'i lam du khyer// rgyal kha chos skyong khyod kyis gyis// snyan grags sngags 'chang bdag la byin// ma g.yel bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod// rdzogs so/// / 1$0000250༈ shan pa srog sgrub nag mo'i srog dbang bzhugs pa'i dbu phyogs lags so// 1$0000300rigs kyi ḍā ki lnga la phyag 'tshal lo// 1$0000250dpon slob bar chad mi 'byung phyir// dkyil 'khor cho ga sgrub pa la// shan pa nag mo'i srog dbang bskur// de la slob dpon thams cad kyis// mdun gyi nam mkha'i dkyil dag tu// 'od phung 'bar ba mtha' yas dkyil// bla ma yi dam ḍā ki dam can tshogs// sprin phung bzhin du gtib par bsgom// mdun du shan pa nag mo 'khor bcas bskyed// rgyal ba rig 'dzin mang bzhin du// ldi ri bzlas rnams 'grub par bsam// gtor tshogs mchod pa rgya chen bsham// gtso 'khor bzhi yi gtor dbang bskur// gtso mo'i gtor ma blangs la mgor bzhag la/

1$0000300bh+yo/ mkha' 'gro nag mo mi srun ma// sha za khrag mig srin mo'i gdong*// 'jigs pa'i gzugs can mkha' 'gro'i gtso// nag mo srid pa'i mtshon cha thogs// ba spu mtshon cha bskal pa'i me// rlung nag zhon nas ral pa sprugs// srid pa'i shugs rtags mi lpags gyon// stong gsum sgrol byed snying dmar zhal du gsol// zhal nas khrag 'dzag kyu ru ru// spyan gsum khro gnyer mche ba gtsigs// ag tshom me 'bar 'tshub ma'i mtshan ma 'gyed// mi mgo'i do shal gsod byed rgya mtshos bskor// o rgyan bka' dang rig 'dzin bla ma'i bka'/ khyad par mkha' 'gros dam btags rjes 'brang ma// dbang bzhi bka' lung bka' yi bstan pa srungs// oṃ khyi kha le nag mos sod/ srog ma tri sod/ snying kha kha bam/ ya ya sod/ rtsa ba ni ri mu sod/ gha ya sod/ nṛ ya sod/ rag mo tsit+ta rbad/ rag mo tsit+ta rbud/ dam tshig ma bsrung na chad pa chod cig /bsrungs na sdongs grogs mdzod cig /1$0000250g.yas kyi gtor ma blangs la/ 1$0000300bh+yo/ sha za dmar mo ce spyang gdong*// ro zhon snying khrag zhal du gsol// g.yas kyi sha za las mdzod cig /1$0000250g.yon gyi gtor ma blangs la/ 1$0000300bh+yo/ nag mo wa gdong rngams pa'i gzugs// ba spu mtshon cha spu gris gtams// re bas stong gsum sgrol byed ma// zhags pa spu gris glo snying 'dren// sha za khrag 'thung rkang rus mur// bka' lung rjes 'brang las mdzod cig /1$0000250mdun gyi gtor ma blangs la/ 1$0000300bh+yo/ mdun nas srog gcod sha za mo// nag mo 'ug gdong gnam lcags sder/ khrag ral mtshon stong dgra snying 'beb// mdun gyi sha zas phrin las mdzod// 1$0000250rgyab nas gtor ma blangs la/ 1$0000300bh+yo/ rgyab nas kham nag dred gdong ma// gnam lcags mchu sder srog rtsa gcod// skad cig stong gsum nyul bar byed// rkan sgras srid gsum snying khrag 'thung*// stong gsum zas za srid gsum skom du 'thung*// gsod byed nag mo 'khor bcas la// sha za khrag 'thung 'bum gyis bskor// dpon g.yog 'khor bcas las mdzod cig

/dbang dang gdams pa'i bka' lung sgo phyes la// dam la gnas pas bka' chad srungs// 1$0000250zhes dbang dang rjes gnang bya'o// rol mo bsgrag /dus ni nyi shar ram/ phyed yol/ sa sros/ nam phyed shis/ 'di'i dus su tshogs gtor bzang ba gal che/ o rgyan bka' lung*/ ye shes mtsho rgyal gyi gdams pa phyag len med thabs med pa rdzogs so// 1$0000300
shan pa 'khor bcas bka' yi bya ra mdzod// lung 'di khrol la 'di'i chos kho la gtod// rang bzo ma byed rjes gnang bzhin du mdzod// dge bar gyur cig /maṅga laṃ/// /
